Схема питания решает, как процессор держ: The power plan decides how the CPU manages its clock speed. On the Balanced plan it lowers the clock when there's no load, so the PC is quieter and runs cooler. On Ultimate Performance the clock stays at full speed all the time. Choose when you need full speed, and the app will switch plans for you.
